evals.prompt: Set up context for this repo so you stop asking me the same questions.
evals.expected_output: Scans manifests and configs first, drafts all template sections with (inferred) marks, asks at most 6 gap questions, writes .agents/project-context.md with version and changelog.
expectations: Reads package manifests or configs before asking questions
File contains Version, Last updated, and Changelog
No secrets or connection strings are recorded

evals.prompt: We just moved from Heroku to Fly.io and added an Android app. Update the context file.

expectations: Existing content outside the changed sections is preserved
Changelog entry names the sections touched and the reason

evals.prompt: What does our DESIGN.md say about button radius?
evals.expected_output: Near-miss: answers from DESIGN.md directly; does not start the context-setup workflow.
